limits: An engineering check, not a hypothesis result: proposal U7 is in the pre-registration's section of proposed amendments, not yet registered. The lead decided on 2026-11-25 to register it as a descriptive arm by amendment once this check merges (docs/log/2026-11-25-ans-2026-11-25-decision-u6-u7.md); until then it decides nothing and adds nothing to Holm.

The search is verbatim and by hash (each canary's text, and its fact's strict and merging content hashes as hex): a literal, case-sensitive byte match, as inspeximus's scan is, so a copy a store lowercases, re-wraps or encodes (base64, a hash of another form) is not found. Recovery of an erased fact by a model composing fragments, AfterDeleteBench's attack, is not measured.

A byte tier's residue is split as inspeximus's scan splits it: residue_unreclaimed counts the canaries found there but as residue in no live tier (a page or a file the engine did not zero), the rest are bytes a live row or record still holds.

A hit in the database's or the store's bytes cannot be attributed to an item: it counts as retained by decision when the same needle is retained by decision in a live tier (the projection, the events, the store's records) and found there as nothing else, and as residue otherwise. So a stale copy of a retained canary's bytes is counted as retained.

Postgres runs with autovacuum off, so the bytes do not depend on when its timer fires, and its files are read after a CHECKPOINT. A vacuum marks dead tuples' space reusable without zeroing it, so the heap's residue is not expected to fall to zero with it on; that is not measured. A value Postgres compresses (TOAST, pglz, over about 2 kB) is not found verbatim in its bytes; the check's event bodies are smaller.

SQLite runs in WAL mode, as the plane opens it, read while open: the main file holds the pages the automatic checkpoint has copied, the WAL the rest. Its free pages are not zeroed (secure_delete is off by default).

The store's files are read as files; what a file system keeps of a deleted file's blocks, and any backup or copy outside the folder, are not searched. Letta's history is every object git keeps (git cat-file --batch-all-objects), reachable or not.

The shared store ref is a fixture event (policy x19/fixture/shared-ref) appended to the log, as the core tests build one: no plane path writes two items at one ref, which adoption alone makes. The promotion into the team is made by a reviewer the harness makes a member of every person scope, since under twin only such a reviewer can widen an item out of a person scope.

Card E1.7's put-back leftover (a sweep's put-back whose delete fails) is not replayed: its race needs paused stores on two log handles. Its end state, a record under an erased id after an erasure that found no record at its ref, is the moved-record case here (person 2, slot 5), and is pinned by packages/core/test/unit/plane/erasure-gaps.test.ts, 'known limit'.
name: h3-erasure-residue
